svg.title: Plasma Projector: an open working head
svg.desc: A top-down space-weapon proposal with two long gunmetal pole faces around a deep open working space, held by a short cyan and blue receiver. Dark and energised complete drawings share identical machinery. A separate pale hot light occupies the open head. The weapon is also shown on current Wasp and Fighter hulls.
svg.text: SVG proposal · top-down construction · energy drawn separately from equipment · no production or final FX implementation
